source._comment: Michigan has NO party registration -> turnout-only. Official: MI SoS 'Michigan Voting Dashboard', a Power BI publish-to-web report on the US Government cloud (iowa cluster); mi_update.py queries it like the page does. It lists each election once the SoS adds it (on 2026-09-29 it held only the 2024 general and the Aug 2026 primary). Until the general appears, the UF Election Lab's MI_county.csv (data provided by the SoS) is the stand-in; the dashboard's county registration counts are added for turnout %.
